title: Wildfly: specially crafted pair of WS-Policy documents can force Neethi's policy-intersection to do exponential…
description: A security vulnerability in Wildfly prior to version 42.0.0-r1 allows a denial of service condition. This occurs when a specially crafted pair of WS-Policy documents triggers Neethi's policy-intersection component to perform exponential computational work, resulting in high CPU usage and service disruption.
